meta.description: Design LinkedIn Ads creative strategy including format selection, visual best practices, Thought Leader Ads, and refresh cadence. Triggers on "LinkedIn ad format", "Thought Leader Ads", "TLA", "Document Ads", "carousel ads", "video ads", "image specs", "creative refresh", "ad fatigue", "LinkedIn ad creative". Do NOT use for ad copy/text (use copy) or bidding (use bidding).
